factor_name: Persistent elevated-VIX residual reversal scaled by downside volatility

calculation.expression: active_if(VIX[t-1] > median(VIX[t-61:t-1)) and VIX[t-2] > median(VIX[t-61:t-1)); signal_i[t] = -(sum_return_i_10d - cross_sectional_median(sum_return_10d)) / downside_std_i_20d
calculation.description: At each ex-ante signal date, require two consecutive completed observations of VIX above its trailing 60-session median. Rank the contrarian 10-session cross-asset residual return, scaled by each asset's trailing 20-session downside volatility. VIX is observation-only and no order is submitted for it.

validation.regime_notes: Small universe of 15 intentionally tradable cross-asset benchmarks; results aggregate 1,391 active dates with approximately 14.25 valid instruments. Persistence filter improves full-sample 5d and 10d IC versus the prior single-observation specification; predictive power decays by 20 sessions. Interpret uncertainty conservatively.
